items.organizationName: TR-CERT (Computer Emergency Response Team of the Republic of Türkiye)
items.scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities in all Ubiquiti products and products of Ubiquiti subsidiaries only.
Siemens issues only.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
ABB issues only.
Pegasystems products only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
Bizerba products only.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All current products/software/apps made by Logitech, Ultimate Ears, Jaybird, Streamlabs, Logitech G, Logicool, Blue, and Astro Gaming.
Zyxel products issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Pentraze Cybersecurity that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Vestel-owned brands and products only.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Yandex issues only.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Roche’s medical technology products.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
openGauss issues only.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
JetBrains products only.
All Snow Software products.
Adobe issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Okta issues only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by Securifera, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments.
Bosch products only.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Hitachi Energy products only.

All products for Haverford Systems brands, PTZOptics and HuddleCamHD (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Haverford Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
All Arista products only.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.

Products supported by Schneider Electric and its affiliates, including products branded Schneider Electric or any other brands owned or controlled by Schneider Electric (such as but not limited to APC, Eliwell, Proface, ProLeit, Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation, etc.), excluding Aveva and RIB products.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
ASR products only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by Patchstack and Patchstack Bug Bounty program unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
